pages.text: Before the doors of every hall where someone waits stands a shrine. Lay your hand on it and it kindles and remembers you.$(br2)But to remember is not to keep vigil. A shrine keeps vigil over you only when you give it a Vigil Shard.

The shards lie in the citadel's chests - no more than a dozen or so in all of it. Each one given to a shrine is one rising before it, with everything you carry; only your experience is lost.$(br2)When no one keeps vigil over you, death is death: what you carried lies where you fell, and you wake where you slept before the citadel.
